verified_facts.text: The Malmaison Penthouse is a two-bedroom penthouse suite in the Reforma Tower with an Angel view and a balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club level, 2 Bedroom Penthouse Suite, Angel view, Reforma Tower, Balcony

verified_facts.text: The Marco Polo Presidential is a three-bedroom presidential suite with an Angel view.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club level, 3 Bedroom Presidential Suite, Angel view, Reforma Tower

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse is on a high floor of the Reforma Tower with an Angel view and a balcony.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located in the Zona Rosa area, surrounded by boutique shopping, nightlife and restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the exciting Zona Rosa area, Sheraton Mexico City Maria Isabel Hotel is surrounded by boutique shopping, dynamic nightlife and eclectic restaurants

verified_facts.text: Guests can walk along Reforma Avenue to Bosque de Chapultepec, home to a zoo, the Museum of Anthropology and Chapultepec Castle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Or walk until you reach Bosque de Chapultepec, one of the Western Hemisphere's largest parks and home to lush greenery, a zoo, the Museum of Anthropology and the Chapultepec Castle.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's location near Centro Historico puts guests within a close distance of the Palacio de Bellas Artes, the National Palace and the Metropolitan Cathedral.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our CDMX hotel's central location near Centro Histórico places you within a close distance of Palacio de Bellas Artes, the National Palace, the Metropolitan Cathedral and other famous landmarks

verified_facts.text: The Angel of Independence, a victory column on Reforma Avenue, is close to the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: this victory column commemorates the centennial of the beginning of Mexico's War of Independence on Reforma Avenue, close to our hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers views of the bustling Reforma Avenue.

verified_facts.excerpt: A space thoughtfully designed for Sheraton Club guests and upper elite tiers to work, connect or simply relax at any time of the day.
